title: Where can you fly direct from Birmingham Airport?
author: Brogan
cover_image_alt: A yellow departures board listing flights to Barcelona, Paris, Budapest, Amsterdam and Istanbul
intro: Birmingham has direct flights to well over a hundred places, from the Canaries to Cancún. Here's where you can fly non-stop, grouped by the kind of trip you want, with the new routes for this winter and next summer.
seo_title: Direct flights from Birmingham: where you can fly (2026/27)
seo_description: Birmingham flies direct to over 100 places, from the Canaries to Cancún. Routes by beach, city break, winter sun and long-haul, plus the new routes for 2026/27.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
Birmingham is the Midlands' biggest airport, with direct flights to well over a hundred destinations. Most are holiday routes to Spain, the Canaries, Portugal, Greece and Turkey, flown by Jet2, Ryanair, easyJet and TUI. There's also a small but useful long-haul network, led by Emirates to Dubai.

We checked these routes in October 2026. Airlines add, drop and move routes every season, and many holiday routes only run in summer, so always check the current timetable before you plan a trip around a flight.

sections.heading: Winter sun: the Canaries and beyond
sections.text:
For winter sun, the Canary Islands are the easy choice, with flights of around four and a half hours and year-round routes from Birmingham:

- **[Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife)**, the most popular, with the warmest, most reliable weather in the south.
- **[Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote)**, smaller and calmer, with volcanic scenery.
- **[Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria)**, with big beaches and a lively capital.
- **[Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura)**, for long, wild beaches.

Further afield, Jet2 has added Egypt's Red Sea resorts, Hurghada and Sharm el-Sheikh, for winter 2026/27. EgyptAir has announced flights to Cairo from late October 2026, and easyJet has announced Agadir in Morocco for this winter. Ryanair has [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) on its winter programme too.

sections.heading: Summer beaches
sections.text:
In summer, the choice from Birmingham is huge. The main routes include:

- **Spain:** [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca), [Ibiza](/destinations/ibiza), [Menorca](/destinations/menorca) and the Costa del Sol via [Málaga](/destinations/malaga), plus Alicante and Barcelona.
- **Portugal:** Faro for the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve).
- **Greece:** islands including [Crete](/destinations/crete), [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes), [Corfu](/destinations/corfu), [Kefalonia](/destinations/kefalonia) and [Zakynthos](/destinations/zakynthos), many of them summer only.
- **Turkey:** [Antalya](/destinations/antalya) and Dalaman, for the Turquoise Coast.
- **Cyprus:** [Paphos](/destinations/paphos).

New for summer 2026, Jet2 added the Greek island of Samos and Palermo in Sicily, and TUI added Tirana in Albania. Jet2 has already announced Thassos in Greece for summer 2027.

sections.heading: City breaks
sections.text:
Birmingham is a good airport for short city breaks, with lots of routes that run all year:

- **Classics:** [Barcelona](/destinations/barcelona), [Amsterdam](/destinations/amsterdam) with KLM, [Paris](/destinations/paris) with Air France, and [Prague](/destinations/prague).
- **Good value:** [Budapest](/destinations/budapest), which TUI added in 2026, and [Krakow](/destinations/krakow), which easyJet has announced from late October 2026.
- **New this winter:** easyJet has announced flights to [Copenhagen](/destinations/copenhagen) from November 2026, and Ryanair and Jet2 have announced Copenhagen too. Ryanair has also announced [Rome](/destinations/rome) Fiumicino and Warsaw. easyJet added [Nice](/destinations/nice) for summer 2026.

If you're not sure which city suits a short trip, our [3-day city breaks in Europe](/blog/best-places-for-a-3-day-city-break-in-europe) post compares flight times and how much you can see. Some of these routes are seasonal or only a few days a week, so check before you book.

sections.heading: Long-haul
sections.text:
Birmingham's long-haul list is short, but it covers the big holiday hubs:

- **[Dubai](/destinations/dubai)** with Emirates, about seven hours. As well as a holiday in itself, it's a good connection to the Maldives, Asia and Australia.
- **Doha** with Qatar Airways, another easy hub for onward flights.
- **Istanbul** with Turkish Airlines, for a city break or onward connections.
- **[Cancún](/destinations/cancun)** with TUI, around ten hours, Birmingham's longest direct route and the gateway to Mexico's Caribbean coast and [Bacalar](/destinations/bacalar).
- **India** with Air India, to Delhi and Amritsar.

Direct flights from Birmingham to the USA are rare, so for New York or Florida you'll usually need to connect or fly from a London airport or Manchester. Check what's running for your dates, as long-haul holiday routes change from season to season.

sections.heading: Which airlines fly from Birmingham?
sections.text:
- **Jet2** has the most holiday destinations from Birmingham, including package holidays, mostly to Spain, the Canaries, Portugal, Greece and Turkey.
- **Ryanair** covers lots of cities and beach resorts, usually with the lowest headline fares.
- **easyJet** flies a mix of beach and city routes.
- **TUI** mainly sells package holidays, including long-haul to Cancún.
- **Wizz Air** focuses on central and eastern Europe.
- **Emirates, Qatar Airways, Turkish Airlines and Air India** fly the long-haul routes.

You can see the airport's full current list of destinations on [Birmingham Airport's website](https://www.birminghamairport.co.uk/).

sections.heading: How to choose where to go
sections.text:
With this many direct routes, the hard part is choosing. A few ways to narrow it down:

- **Pick the month first.** Our month pages, like [where to go in February](/destinations/where-to-go-in-february) and [where to go in July](/destinations/where-to-go-in-july), show where's warm and good at that time of year.
- **Then filter by type:** [beach holidays](/destinations/beach-holidays), [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) or [holidays in Spain](/destinations/holidays-in-spain).
- **Shortlist three or four direct routes** and compare flight days and times, not just prices.

If you're planning with family or friends who all want somewhere different, put the shortlist on [somewhere.party](/) and let everyone give their favourites points.

faqs.question: Does Birmingham Airport have long-haul flights?
faqs.answer: Yes, a few. Emirates flies to Dubai, Qatar Airways to Doha, Turkish Airlines to Istanbul, Air India to Delhi and Amritsar, and TUI to Cancún. Direct flights to the USA are rare, so most people connect or fly from London or Manchester.

faqs.question: Which airlines fly from Birmingham Airport?
faqs.answer: The biggest are Jet2, Ryanair, easyJet and TUI, with Wizz Air for central and eastern Europe. Emirates, Qatar Airways, Turkish Airlines and Air India fly the long-haul routes.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Birmingham to the Canary Islands?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tenerife, Lanzarote, Gran Canaria and Fuerteventura all have direct flights from Birmingham, mostly all year, taking around four and a half hours.

faqs.question: What new routes are there from Birmingham for winter 2026/27?
faqs.answer: Announced routes include Copenhagen with easyJet, Ryanair and Jet2, Cairo with EgyptAir, Agadir with easyJet, Hurghada and Sharm el-Sheikh with Jet2, and Ryanair to Rome Fiumicino, Marrakech, Tirana and Warsaw. Check the airline for exact dates.
